messages:
maya: kicking off a guarded bring-up for `rwd-v3-int4` focused on long-context fidelity. starting 1% in us-east, with seeded cache for safety slices. :rocket:

kevin: what's the staged pct plan and abort thresholds?

maya: 1% -> 7% -> 25% over 36h. autofallback if any of these hit: longdoc_mrr_drop >= 1.6% abs, halluc_rate_delta > 0.025, or p99_latency_up > 85ms. quick config below.

sasha: paste the YAML so I can wire the eval runner.

maya:
```yaml
canary_id: rwd-v3-int4-seedcache-1
route: hosted/us-east
steps:
  - pct: 1
    duration_h: 8
  - pct: 7
    duration_h: 16
  - pct: 25
    duration_h: 12
signals:
  - name: longdoc_mrr
    compare_to: baseline
    direction: decrease
  - name: hallucination_rate
    direction: increase
  - name: p99_latency_ms
    direction: increase
abort_rules:
  - metric: longdoc_mrr
    op: "<="
    threshold_delta: -0.016
  - metric: hallucination_rate
    op: ">"
    threshold_delta: 0.025
  - metric: p99_latency_ms
    op: ">"
    threshold_delta: 85
cache_warm_policy:
  seed_slices: ["legal_longdocs", "finance_reports"]
  seed_requests: 500
autofallback: true
trace_flags: ["kv_cache_stats", "model_tokens_breakdown"]
```

arjun: seeding caches for safety slices is good. please also run a coldstart-only shadow to measure the worst-case delta so we don't misattribute early noise.

kevin: ran a quick offline AB on a 12k legal-doc sample: longdoc_mrr_delta=-0.009, p50_latency=-28ms, halluc_rate=+0.006. CI looks tight but will run slice bootstrap.

sasha: reminder to include the long-context eval harness with conversation-rewrite prompts — those tend to expose hallucination regressions for this model family.

maya: noted. eval runner scheduled, bootstrap ETA ~1.5h. will hold at 1% until CI lands.

deploy-bot: started canary rwd-v3-int4-seedcache-1 at 1729403210. initial pct=1%. dashboard: /canaries/rwd-v3-int4-seedcache-1

kevin: bootstrap finished: legal_longdocs CI delta = -0.013 +/- 0.004 (95% CI). doesn't cross abort threshold but close. recommend extra monitoring and extended eval at 7%.

arjun: enable kv_cache_stats traces now and tag the first 1k requests with `cache_warm=true` to be safe. also capture tokenization diffs for long inputs.

maya: done. moving to 7% in 30m if no alerts. will post metrics after each step. thanks. :thumbsup:
